en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a quiet village street lined with gabled houses. A horse‑drawn cart stands on the left side near an inn or guesthouse, and a small child is visible in the middle of the unpaved road. The architecture is typical of early 20th‑century Central Europe. Printed at the top in German is the caption identifying the place and the specific street.
